te: 4 government agencies explain how they are preparing citizen's manuals and online services
se: Representatives of the Office of the Permanent Secretary to the Prime Minister's Office, the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Interior, the Department of Local Administration and the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration explained how they prepare citizen's manuals, electronic services, and problems found such as data links between agencies. The meeting was of the view that the information should be used in the study.
it: Office of the Permanent Secretary to the Prime Minister's Office: 4 services already have electronic systems and manuals
Office of the Permanent Secretary for Interior: citizen's manuals for 459 services, and how it is preparing
Department of Local Administration: 13 manuals, and problems with data links, late reporting of incidents and oversight of local authorities
Bangkok Metropolitan Administration: review of the manuals for 272 procedures, improvement of e-Services and connection to the central application centre

te: Hearing from the OPDC on civil service development and digital government
se: A representative of the OPDC gave information on making public administration more efficient under the National Strategy, the move to digital government, obstacles such as overlapping rules and budget limits, and progress in preparing to use the new facilitation law.
it: Information from the OPDC on the civil service development strategy, digital government and progress of the new facilitation law

te: First meeting, approach set for studying better public services
se: The subcommittee chose its study topic: making public administration more efficient to improve services to the public, looking at technology and smart governance to cut steps and paperwork, in line with the Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. 2569 (2026)
it: Topic and approach of the study set: making public administration more efficient to improve services to the public

te: Justice system: structural problems and reform options
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Office of Justice Affairs and the Lawyers Council of Thailand under Royal Patronage to give information and exchange views on structural problems of the criminal justice system, concrete reform proposals and preventing re-offending. The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Justice system: reform and personal data protection
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Faculty of Law, Thammasat University, and the Office of the Personal Data Protection Committee to give information and exchange views on structural problems of the justice system, improving the Criminal Procedure Code, the use of AI, and the effects of the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) on the justice system. The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Justice system: the roles of the Courts of Justice and public prosecutors
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Office of the Courts of Justice and the Office of the Attorney General to give information and exchange views on the role of the courts and public prosecutors in the justice system (according to the meeting notice). The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Justice system: enforcement of judgments and corrections
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Legal Execution Department and the Department of Corrections to give information and exchange views on case backlogs and ways to speed up enforcement of judgments, data links between agencies, reducing prison overcrowding, alternatives to imprisonment, and preparing inmates to return to society. The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Justice system: the roles of the Ministry of Interior and the Department of Special Investigation
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Interior, the Department of Provincial Administration and the Department of Special Investigation to give information and exchange views on the role of agencies in the justice system (according to the meeting notice). The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Welfare and benefits for military personnel and their heirs after fighting in border areas
se: The subcommittee invited the Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters, the Royal Thai Army, Navy and Air Force, the Royal Thai Armed Forces Records Department and the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Defence to give information on adjusting allowances, speeding up budget spending for welfare, the rules on royal decorations, and other benefits that should be given fairly and equally.
it: Welfare, rights and benefits for personnel of all 3 armed services and their heirs, during and after fighting in border areas

te: Justice system: preventing and suppressing corruption
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Office of the Public Sector Anti-Corruption Commission, the Anti-Corruption Division and the Inquiry Officials Association to give information and exchange views on the role of anti-corruption agencies and criminal inquiry work (according to the meeting notice). The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Water resource management, Rayong Province: wastewater and raw water sources in the EEC area
se: The subcommittee invited the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, the Royal Irrigation Department, the Office of the National Water Resources and the Wastewater Management Authority to give information on plans for wastewater treatment in the Eastern Economic Corridor, water-quality control plans and bringing all raw water sources together.
it: Water resource management in Rayong Province: wastewater treatment, water quality and raw water sources in the EEC area

te: Justice system: preventing and suppressing drugs
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Office of the Narcotics Control Board, the Narcotics Suppression Bureau, the Department of Mental Health and field workers in Chaiyaphum Province to give information and exchange views on problems, limits and solutions from the view of central agencies and people working in the field, so that administration in this area is effective and in line with the rule of law. The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Justice system: preventing technology crime, with the NBTC and the private sector
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Office of the NBTC, banks, and mobile-phone and payment service providers to give information and exchange views on the situation and statistics of technology crime, its effects on the public, and approaches or innovations to prevent and reduce losses. The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Justice system: technology crime and money laundering
se: The subcommittee invited representatives of the Ministry of Digital Economy and Society, the Technology Crime Suppression Operations Centre and the Anti-Money Laundering Office to give information and exchange views on preventing and solving technology crime, helping victims, tracking and arresting offenders, and working with the police. The subcommittee will gather the information for its study and make proposals to the government.
it: Study of the system and structure of the justice process as it affects state administration

te: Follow-up on the work of 3 working groups, and preparations for the seminar "Bangkok in 2030: Sink or Survive?"
se: The meeting noted progress of 3 working groups: crises and disasters for national security, integrated water management in Rayong Province, and the effects of the Thai justice system; discussed preparing a work report for the Senate; and prepared a seminar on disaster risks in urban areas.
it: Results of the work of 3 working groups
Preparing information to present the committee's work to the Senate
Preparing a seminar on "Bangkok in 2030: Sink or Survive?"

se: The subcommittee invited the Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR), the Provincial Waterworks Authority, the Department of Industrial Works, the Industrial Estate Authority of Thailand, the Royal Irrigation Department and related agencies to give information on water management in Rayong Province (according to the meeting notice)
it: Water resource management in Rayong Province
